parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package — a path that contains 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp', which is a sample-app directory. The canonical copy resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (DebugPanel package). It is common practice to copy a debug HUD component verbatim into a sample app so the sample app remains self-contained and does not take a hard dependency on the DebugPanel library target. Although the duplication is exact, the sample-app context makes it intentional rather than an oversight worth refactoring.
